verdict_reason: Exercises listLiveAddresses against real Mongo for country codes, search pattern, several roles and role-or-searchRole scoping, each assertion pinning the exact kept rows; only a Minor title-convention breach.

todos.issue: Test titles break the IT naming pattern {subject}_{shouldDoWhat}_{whenContext}: findByIdAndOrganisationId_returnsAddress_whenOrganisationMatches (:29), findByIdAndOrganisationId_returnsEmpty_whenOrganisationDiffers (:40), and every listLiveAddresses_with..._is.../matches.../keeps... title (:49, :61, :73, :85, :100, :125) put the context before the outcome and drop 'should', unlike the sibling AddressListIT and AddressUpdateIT in the same PR.
todos.fix: Must: every test title in AddressRepositoryIT follows {subject}_{shouldDoWhat}_{whenContext}. One way: listLiveAddresses_shouldKeepAddressesHoldingAnyOfTheRoles_whenSeveralRolesAreGiven, findByIdAndOrganisationId_shouldReturnEmpty_whenOrganisationDiffers.
